app.RWxldmVuTGFicw.desc.source:
Provides integration with [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io) AI voice synthesis and audio processing services.

Supported operations:
- **Speech synthesis**: text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, voice design
- **Audio processing**: audio isolation, text-to-sound-effects
- **Transcription**: speech-to-text with speaker diarization
- **Voice management**: create, edit, delete, and list voices
- **Dubbing**: create and manage dubbing projects
- **Pronunciation**: manage pronunciation dictionaries
app.RWxldmVuTGFicw.desc.message:
提供與 [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io) AI 語音合成與音訊處理服務的整合。

支援的操作：
- **語音合成**：文字轉語音、語音轉語音、聲音設計
- **音訊處理**：音訊隔離、文字轉音效
- **轉錄**：含說話者分離的語音轉文字
- **聲音管理**：建立、編輯、刪除與列出聲音
- **配音**：建立與管理配音專案
- **發音**：管理發音字典
